memory_behavior.new_memory: Create a new memory when the user explicitly asks NEXO to remember something.
memory_behavior.update_memory: Update an existing memory when the user provides newer information that replaces it.
memory_behavior.deactivate_memory: Mark a memory inactive when it is no longer valid instead of automatically deleting it.
memory_behavior.delete_memory: Delete a memory when the user explicitly asks NEXO to forget it.
memory_behavior.temporary_conversation: Do not store normal conversations as memories.
